title: Onboard lumen-14b-v1.0: add model metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Martinez
description: Onboard lumen-14b-v1.0 to the model registry and add associated performance profiles and changelog automation. Motivation: Lumen-14B is an open, inference-optimized decoder model that our benchmarks show is a cost-effective option for mid-latency, high-throughput workloads. This PR includes: 1) model metadata (manifest, tags, weight SHA, supported precisions and recommended quantization profiles), 2) performance profiles for A100/H100/T4 baseline and quantized variants (int8, fq4), 3) a small validation harness and perf-summary CSV from internal bench runs, 4) updates to the changelog generation GH Action to auto-emit a model onboarding entry when new model manifests are added, and 5) docs and example prompt wrapper for SDK samples. Implementation notes: - Model manifest added under models/lumen-14b/v1.0/manifest.yaml with schema_version=2.1 and fields: name, version, weights_sha256, tags, supported_precisions, recommended_quantization_profiles, inference_defaults. - Perf profiles placed in perf-profiles/lumen-14b/v1.0/ with JSON files per-hardware (a100.json, h100.json, t4.json) including p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec for batch sizes [1,4,8,16], and an int8_quantized_variants/ subfolder. - Benchmarks: aggregated results from perf-canary runs (see perf-summary.csv) show median throughput improvements vs baseline-7b and latency within SLA for 2k token windows on H100. - CI: added model validation step (checks manifest schema, weight SHA existence, and basic tokenization smoke test) and updated changelog-generator step to look for new manifest additions and create a release note fragment. - Backwards compatibility: registry schema bump to 2.1 is additive (new optional keys); changelog automation only triggers for new model manifest additions or perf-profile diffs. See release_notes below for public-facing text.
commits: 6 commits: initial manifest and perf-profile drafts; add perf summaries from perf-canary; fix quantization profile keys; add model validation CI check; update changelog-generator action to create model onboarding fragments; docs and examples update.
review_comments: Ravi Patel: Please include the exact weights SHA used for the published tarball and confirm license compatibility. Also add a note about the tokenizer version used for benchmarks.
Ava Martinez: Added weights SHA and tokenizer_version in manifest.yaml, and added license note. Re-ran perf-canary with tokenizer v2.1 to produce perf-summary.csv.

Elena Kovalev: Perf numbers look good on H100 but T4 numbers are surprising — can you confirm the quantization pipeline used and the backend kernels? Suggest adding a note about fallback accuracy expectations.

Ava Martinez: Expanded quantization_profile docs with the exact pipeline used (huggingface->onnx->int8 calibration using 500 calibration samples) and added accuracy regression note and test vector in docs.
Marcus Lee: Model validation CI step failed on first run due to missing tokenizer package in the action. Fixed and re-run; all checks green.
release_notes: - Onboarded lumen-14b v1.0: new 14B open decoder model optimized for inference. Includes verified performance profiles for A100/H100/T4 and recommended quantization profiles (int8, fq4). - Registry schema bumped to 2.1 (additive): supports explicit recommended_quantization_profiles and tokenizer_version. - Changelog automation: GitHub Action now auto-generates a model onboarding fragment when a new manifest is added; reduces manual release note churn.
notes_for_ops: Model added to registry; ops should ensure weights are staged to the artifact bucket before release. The perf profiles include recommended instance types and batch sizes; autoscaler policies should reference perf-profiles/lumen-14b/v1.0 when estimating throughput targets.
qa_summary: Included model-validation CI check which verifies manifest schema, weight SHA presence, tokenizer compatibility smoke test, and a small inference run against 5 canonical prompts. Perf-canary runs produced perf-summary.csv; results validated by Elena and Marcus.
follow_up: 1) Add long-run accuracy regression tests to central eval-harness (ENG-4180). 2) Add example in redwood-quickstarts to demonstrate cost/latency tradeoffs for lumen-14b (PM-122).
